name: Chest Pain or Pressure
message: Patient reports chest pain or pressure — immediate emergency screening required.

name: Severe Difficulty Breathing
message: Patient reports severe difficulty breathing — cannot speak in full sentences or is gasping for air.

name: Altered or Loss of Consciousness
message: Patient reports loss of consciousness, fainting, or acute confusion.

name: Severe Uncontrolled Bleeding
message: Patient reports severe uncontrolled bleeding that won't stop despite direct pressure.

name: Active Stroke Symptoms
message: Patient reports active stroke symptoms (FAST: facial drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty).

name: Suicidal Ideation or Intent
message: Patient reports suicidal ideation or intent to self-harm.

name: Anaphylaxis
message: Patient reports anaphylaxis — severe systemic allergic reaction with throat swelling or systemic collapse.

name: Dangerously High Fever
message: Patient reports a dangerously high fever (≥103°F / 39.4°C).

name: Unable to Walk or Bear Weight
message: Patient reports complete inability to walk, stand, or bear weight.

name: Severe Acute Abdominal Pain
message: Patient reports severe acute abdominal pain — sharp, stabbing, or crushing.
